subcategories.description: List of subcategory names under this category

display_order.description: Order in which this category should appear in filters

is_active.description: Whether this category is currently active

excluded_role_ids.description: Member role IDs that cannot see this category (and resources exclusively tagged with its subcategories). Empty array means all roles can see it. A category with any exclusions is member-only (hidden from guests).

applies_to_content_types.description: Content types this category's filters apply to (e.g., Articles only use Theme, Resources use Theme and Level)
